paragraphs.text: A planar portal is an artificial way to travel through the aether between planes , without needing a planeswalker's spark . Planar portals can be created by planeswalkers , but the Thran and the Phyrexians also had the technology.
The Caves of Koilos portal to Phyrexia, created by the planeswalker Dyfed .
The second portal to Phyrexia, opened by Jarsyl .
The Jamuraan portals to Wildfire and Rabiah .
The portals in the skies that captured its citizens from other planes.
The portal within the throne room of the Stronghold which allowed Yawgmoth to enter Dominaria personally during the Phyrexian Invasion .
The Erratic Portal between Rath (originally on Phyrexia itself when used by Ramos ) and Mercadia , guarded by the Soltari .
The Dwarven Gate in the abandoned dwarven city under Castle Sengir on Ulgrotha . Where it leads is unknown.
Phyrexian portal ships , used as invading forces
Phyrexian ambulators as well as the Venser-built ambulator from similar artifacts; these are covert static portals for infiltrators

Valgavoth 's doors to Duskmourn . A (temporary) door to Oboro on Kamigawa . A door to Ravnica . Quarantined by the Izzet League for study A (temporary) door to Alquist Proft 's mind palace. A door to Arcavios . Based on its embellishments the door connects to the Quandrix study wing of Strixhaven A door to Kaldheim . The door;s has a design indicating it connects to King Harald 's feasting hall in Skemfar . A door that has hedrons and is inferred to lead to Zendikar .

When the Mending occurred, all artificial planar portals stopped working. New tech was possible, but so far the only example seen is the Planar Bridge , which had major limitations transporting organic matter.

Valgavoth , the demonic overlord of Duskmourn , had the capability to generate portals out of his domain in the guise of wooden doors. However, creating these doors took significant effort, so Valgavoth could only manage a door every few years. Given the nature of the plane, considering them methods of travel is ill-advised.

After the War of the Spark , Tezzeret allied with New Phyrexia in exchange for a new darksteel body, allowing the Praetors to travel to other planes via the Planar Bridge. Elesh Norn sent Vorinclex to Kaldheim to retrieve tyrite which was used to create the Invasion Tree, Realmbreaker . Realmbreaker used the dynamics of the World Tree 's Omenpaths as a way to forcibly link planes from New Phyrexia across the multiverse. Despite New Phyrexia later being pocketed away into the Zhalfirin planar knot and Realmbreaker's demise, the Omenpaths still exist across the multiverse, additionally influenced by the detonation of the Filigree Sylex in the Blind Eternities .
Following the New Phyrexian Invasion and the use of Realmbreaker , Omenpaths began opening across all the planes , allowing non-planeswalkers to cross the boundaries between them.

After the Invasion, Valgavoth was able to create doors to Duskmourn more easily. This led to him to open a greater number of doors more frequently, reducing the need to maintain a sustainable food supply of survivors within The House.
